responsibility: Defines rustc_infer’s trait-resolution layer: it provides the core obligation data model and public entry points for trait solving, the engine interface for registering and discharging predicate obligations, projection normalization and its snapshot-aware cache for associated types, shared utilities for canonicalizing, elaborating, deduplicating, and traversing relevant supertraits, structural implementations that make these trait data structures participate in folding, visiting, and debugging, and trait-specific diagnostics for reporting inference-time trait errors such as stricter-than-trait impl requirements and object-safety violations.
